name: pygfx
role: Python scene-graph 3D renderer on wgpu (Metal on macOS) with an offscreen canvas
summary: Python render engine in the Three.js mould on wgpu-py: meshes, lines, points, text, volumes and PBR materials. With rendercanvas's offscreen canvas it renders to NumPy RGBA arrays without a window, so a scene can be a function of t in one Python process.
use_when: Render a 3D scene from Python through a modern GPU API (Metal, Vulkan, D3D) without a browser
Draw meshes or point data from NumPy, trimesh or build123d output in the same process
avoid_when: Scientific meshes, volumes and analysis in Python: vedo
A browser scene captured by seeking: three-js
Offline path-traced or production shots: blender-background

install.macos: python3 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install pygfx==0.18.0 wgpu==0.33.0 rendercanvas==3.0.1

notes: 2026-11-27: the lead's version (0.18.0, PyPI 2026-11-17) and BSD-2-Clause matched the registry; PyPI lists Python >=3.11. Rotations use pylinalg (pygfx.linalg does not exist). Offscreen canvas is rendercanvas.offscreen.RenderCanvas; canvas.draw() returns the RGBA array.
2026-11-27: pre-1.0, so pin pygfx, wgpu and rendercanvas together. Pixel hashes are only claimed on one Apple M3 Pro Metal adapter; other GPUs may differ.

assessment.rationale: PyPI 0.18.0 uploaded 2026-11-17, BSD-2-Clause, pure-Python wheels over wgpu-py. Nothing catalogued is a Python-native wgpu renderer: vedo is VTK, trimesh has no modern renderer, dawn-node-webgpu is Node. Offscreen rendering to arrays was verified on a machine without installing anything globally.

evidence.result: 9 checks pass: 24 frames of a lit cube and orbiting sphere at 320x180 from Python offscreen on Metal (Apple M3 Pro); repeat, seeded shuffled order, fresh renderer and a second process all give identical SHA-256 per frame; loop closes at t=2.0. wgpu 0.33.0, Python 3.12.2.
evidence.scope: Offscreen render to RGBA arrays is deterministic in t on one Apple M3 Pro Metal adapter; not other GPUs or drivers, glTF, text, volumes, post-processing, video assembly or large sizes.
